title: Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards: Card Types and Value Limits Schedule
content:
The Northgate Gift Cards and Merchandise Return Cards program is made up of six card types. Each card type is issued only for the reasons listed against it in this schedule; each card's value at issue lies between the smallest and the largest initial value of its type; and no card holds more than the largest balance of its type at any time. All amounts are in US dollars.

## Card types and the reasons for which each is issued

| Card type | Sold to or issued for | Format | Reasons for which the type is issued |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | consumers and businesses | physical | a purchase of the card |
| Northgate eGift Card | consumers and businesses | digital | a purchase of the card; a protection plan claim reimbursement |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | issued for no-receipt returns and gift-receipt returns | physical or digital | the refund of a no-receipt return; the refund of a gift-receipt return |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | issued for promotions | physical or digital | a promotion |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | businesses only, on a bulk order of at least 250.00 | physical or digital | a business bulk order |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | consumers only, with registration required | physical | a purchase of the card |

## Value limits by card type (USD)

| Card type | Smallest value the card can be issued with | Largest value the card can be issued with | Largest balance the card may hold at any time |
|---|---|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card | 5.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 |
| Northgate eGift Card | 5.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card | 0.01 | 2500.00 | 2500.00 |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card | 5.00 | 100.00 | 100.00 |
| Northgate Business Bulk Gift Card | 5.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 |
| Northgate Reloadable Gift Card | 10.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 |

## Notes on the schedule

- The smallest and the largest initial values are themselves values a card can be issued with, so both ends of each range are included.
- Only the Northgate Reloadable Gift Card has a largest balance above its largest initial value: it is issued with at most 500.00 and may hold up to 1000.00 at any time.
- The reasons column is the full list for each type; for example, a Northgate Promotional Gift Card is issued only for a promotion, and a Northgate eGift Card is the only type issued for a protection plan claim reimbursement.

## Boundary illustrations (hypothetical values)

| Hypothetical card at issue | Within the limits? |
|---|---|
| Northgate Gift Card issued with 5.00 | yes, equal to the smallest value |
| Northgate Gift Card issued with 4.99 | no, below the smallest value |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card issued with 100.00 | yes, equal to the largest value |
| Northgate Promotional Gift Card issued with 100.01 | no, above the largest value |
| Northgate Merchandise Return Card issued with 0.01 | yes, equal to the smallest value |
